text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While helping out with Agnes Tachyon's physical modification experiment,
she asked for my input, and when I gave my honest answer—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Huh, the experiment's effect isn't clear?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Really now! What a truly characteristic,
truly, utterly mediocre opinion of yours!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...However... hmm.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Could one say the effect is so faint...
that an ordinary human can't observe it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, time for a re-experiment!
This time, we test at maximum output!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (KABOOM!!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief. Did I go a bit too far?
Trainer-ku~n, are you alri~ght?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I tried to reply with "I'm fine," but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Mokyu?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: This is magnificent! Muscle strength, hormone levels—your values have increased remarkably! However—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: You're saying you can only make sounds like a guinea pig now?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if it's the aftereffect of that accident earlier, after all.
Did the increase in muscle mass affect the vocal cords, or did some kind of change occur in the language center?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "In any case! This change is utterly fascinating! Let us investigate it thoroughly!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"And so, it's time for physical measurements!
For now, let's try measuring with human-sized equipment!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Creak... SNAP!!*)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh!! The grip strength dynamometer is completely shattered?!
What about the recoil?! Do you feel any muscle fatigue?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha!
I have no idea what you're talking about~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"An experiment in mobility and endurance!
100 laps around the court while dribbling!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Good, good, we got some great data!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
How about pulling the Umamusume training tire just like that!
I'd love some data taken right at your absolute limit!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What was that?
I have no idea what you're talking about~?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, this is trouble.
It seems the current you is beyond my power to stop!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (RUUUUMBLE!!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Incredible, Trainer-kun!
Right now, you have the muscle power of an Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Behold the potential of physical transformation! Well!?
Even as a Trainer, doesn't it make your blood boil with—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...
Hmm, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...That's enough.
Let us end the experiment here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It seems all the experiments are finished. But
if we can't communicate like this..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...You're blinking a lot.
And there's visible muscle tension, too.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What reason could there possibly be for anxiety?
You have an unprecedented genius scientist right here, you know?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, you make for a splendid subject of research.
However—"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Advancing research requires diverse perspectives.
No matter how mundane they might be.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Oh, if you're so moved,
how about testing a new experimental medicine next... wait, hmm?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—It seems the change was only temporary.
Your physical readings are back to normal.
choice_data_list: Ahhh, I'm so glad we made it back...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Though I wouldn't have minded
running a few more experiments with you like that.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
So? How does it feel
to become a "guinea pig human"?!
choice_data_list: I felt lonely when I couldn't talk to you.
I felt lonely when I couldn't talk with you.
All that frustration feels like it turned into raw power.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
So? How does it feel
to become a "guinea pig human"?!
choice_data_list: I felt lonely when I couldn't talk to you.
I felt lonely when I couldn't talk with you.
All that frustration feels like it turned into raw power.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: That is not what I was asking, though?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Like muscle fatigue during the experiment!
Or sensory differences before and after the change!
Give me a scientific report! Come on, come on!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, Agnes Tachyon, her eyes sparkling, bombarded me with a barrage of questions.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. So the sublimation of frustration
had a potent effect on physical capabilities...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yes, truly fascinating! Let us delve deeper
and thoroughly investigate that mechanism!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Though the mechanism behind the change remained unknown...
this incident ended up influencing Agnes Tachyon's research."
